About &AI — Patent Litigation AI Company | &AI

# Our vision

Co-founders Herbie Turner and Caleb Harris met at MIT, where they both studied computer science through undergraduate and graduate school. Caleb went on to serve as a technical expert in patent litigation, whereas Herbie built his career in machine learning and AI. Through the lenses of procurement and litigation, both saw the inefficiencies in the patent system. Proving validity or infringement required such deep technical analysis that countless inventions and billions in potential licensing revenue remained locked away.

In 2024, LLMs reached the sophistication needed to handle the scientific complexity of patent material and the ambiguity of drafting. This insight sparked Herbie and Caleb to found &AI with an early team of MIT engineers with experience from Google, Meta, and Citadel Securities. The goal was to build the system that makes patent litigation efficient and unlock new revenue opportunities for asset holders, funders, litigators, and clients alike.

Product Overview | &AI

# The AI workspace for patent litigation

End-to-end patent litigation workflows, from business development to trial.

Patent litigators use &AI to generate new business and deliver winning outcomes. Search prior art, generate claim charts, and draft contentions—all in one workspace that keeps your team aligned from pitch to trial.

### Prior Art Search

Search 60M+ patents and the full internet of NPL and products—all in one place.

### Claim Charts

Generate litigation-ready claim charts in minutes.

### Business Development

Grow your practice as both plaintiff and defense counsel.

### Invalidity Analysis

Build robust arguments for §101, §102, §103, and §112.

### Infringement Detection

Find evidence of use faster with product search and analysis.

## Explore patent litigation AI

What makes &AI different from other patent tools?

&AI is built specifically for end-to-end patent litigation workflows, from business development to trial. Every feature is optimized to produce trial-ready work product, with outputs designed for expert review and legal proceedings.

How does pricing work?

We offer Pro and Enterprise plans. Pro is a monthly per-seat subscription that includes credits, with the option to purchase more as needed. See more pricing details here.

What is &AI?

&AI is an AI workspace for patent litigation. Litigators use it to run prior art search, build invalidity and evidence-of-use claim charts, analyze §101/§102/§103/§112 positions, and source new business—all in one platform, with citation-backed outputs built for expert review and court.

What is patent litigation AI?

Patent litigation AI is software that uses large language models and search to accelerate litigation work—prior art and product searches, claim construction, invalidity and evidence-of-use charts, and drafting contentions. &AI is a patent litigation AI workspace built specifically for litigators, not a general-purpose legal AI tool.

Who uses &AI?

Patent litigators at law firms—from Am Law 100 to IP boutiques—and in-house IP teams use &AI for prior art search, invalidity and infringement analysis, claim charts, and business development.

Does &AI train AI models on my data?

No. &AI and its model providers never train on your or your clients’ data. Zero-data-retention is configured with model providers, and the platform supports SSO, role-based access controls, and encryption in transit and at rest.

How is &AI different from general-purpose legal AI tools?

General legal AI handles broad tasks like contract review or research across practice areas. &AI is purpose-built for patent litigation, with workflows for prior art search, §102/§103/§112 invalidity, evidence-of-use charts, and pitch generation—producing trial-ready, citation-backed work product.

How can I get started?

Can I try &AI for free?

Yes. You can sign up today and start a 7-day free trial. If you would prefer a walkthrough first, you can also book a demo.

How does billing work?

All plans include access to the same &AI platform. Pay as you go customers purchase credits at a standard rate. Pro includes a monthly or annual credit bundle at a lower effective credit rate, with additional credits available after the included amount. Payments are processed through Stripe.

Enterprise pricing is customized for larger teams, security requirements, and volume usage.

Do all plans include the same platform access?

Yes. All plans include access to the same core &AI platform. Plans differ by how credits are purchased, the credit rate, and Enterprise options like SSO, RBAC, deployment, support, and invoicing.
